title: Principal Consultant (Environmental & Social)
description:
**Job Description**  
As a Principal Consultant at ESC, you will play a leadership role supporting high‑quality environmental and planning‑phase consultancy services across Asia. Reporting to senior management, you will provide strategic support for feasibility studies, environmental and social impact assessments (EIA/ESIA/ESHIA), baseline and scoping programmes, permitting strategies and multidisciplinary planning assignments. You will lead teams of consultants and associate consultants, oversee complex and high‑risk projects, guide technical quality, strengthen client relationships and drive business development through proposal leadership, tendering, budgeting and service‑line growth. This role requires strong commercial judgement, sector expertise and the ability to steer teams toward robust, timely and client‑focused outcomes.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic oversight and technical direction across complex planning‑phase projects, ensuring high‑quality, timely and compliant deliverables.
* Lead service areas such as EIA/ESIA/ESHIA, feasibility studies, planning‑phase baseline design, permitting strategies and early‑stage environmental and social advisory.
* Serve as a key client focal point, leading and supporting senior‑level engagements, project shaping and long‑term relationship development.
* Drive business development efforts including proposal development, tender submissions, project budgeting and positioning strategies.
* Manage, mentor and grow teams of consultants and associate consultants, fostering collaboration, technical excellence and professional development.
* Oversee project financial performance, resource planning, risk mitigation and cross‑office coordination.
* Support multi‑disciplinary integration across planning, environmental, social, biodiversity, risk and sustainability functions.
* Champion knowledge sharing, capability building and development of best practices within the function and across ESC.

**Job Requirements**

* Minimum 10–15 years of professional experience in planning phase environmental consulting, including ESIA/EIA/ESHIA, feasibility studies, permitting or related advisory.
* Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, environmental engineering, planning or a related discipline; a Master’s degree is an advantage.
* Proven track record in business development, tendering, proposal leadership and project budgeting.
* Strong analytical, strategic planning and project management skills, including leadership of multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage complex, sensitive or high-profile client engagements.
* Strong understanding of regional environmental and planning regulations, impact assessment frameworks and international best practice.
* High level of professional integrity, sound judgement and ability to work effectively across teams and geographies.

**Employment Type:** Full-time

title: Junior Environmental Engineer
description:
### **How you can make your mark**

As a Junior Environmental Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our projects adhere to environmental regulations and standards. You will be responsible for executing comprehensive environmental monitoring and management plans, providing technical advisory, and ensuring compliance with environmental policies.

**Your responsibilities as a Junior Environmental Engineer:**

* Execute an environmental monitoring and management plan to reduce and mitigate potential negative impacts on the environment.
* Assist in providing technical advisory on environmental policies and standards, ensuring regulatory compliance, and assessing project-specific environmental requirements and specifications.
* Conduct research and technical audits on the environmental impact of projects, analyse data, perform quality control checks, and conduct on-site inspections for instrumentation and monitoring works.
* Collaborate with scientists, engineers, subcontractors, and consultants to develop environmental solutions, and document and maintain plans, requirements, protocols, permits, and standard operating procedures.
* Develop requests for quotations for environmental monitoring scopes, assess environmentally related proposals from potential subcontractors, and contribute to construction risk assessments from an environmental management perspective.

**Your qualities**

You can make your mark as a Junior Environmental Engineer

* Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Marine, Geography, or a related field, with 0 to 3 years of relevant experience in environmental monitoring/management.
* Preferred knowledge of software such as Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, CAD, and GIS; familiarity with programming languages like Python or R is advantageous.
* Full proficiency in English, both written and spoken, is required for effective communication with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and nationalities.
* Organized, analytical, proactive, self-motivated, and a good team player with strong problem-solving and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work in a dynamic environment with various stakeholders, and flexibility to meet project requirements and deliverables, which may occasionally include weekends and public holidays.

### **We offer**

**What you can expect**

* Career opportunities: We challenge you every day to get better. Together, we realize your full personal and professional career by creating development opportunities.
* Warm welcome: We warmly welcome our new colleagues, so they feel at home as soon as possible. During your onboarding program, we give you all the ins and outs of Boskalis!
* Career development: Plenty of opportunities to realize your full potential. Challenge yourself with (online) courses in our Boskalis academy.

**Extra information**

* Your team: You will be part of the Environmental team.
* Where you will work: You will be working in Singapore on-site at the project office of Tuas Terminal Phase 2.
* Fulltime/ part-time job: The position of a junior environmental engineer is a full-time job.

### **About Boskalis**

Working at Boskalis is about creating new horizons and sustainable solutions. In a world where population growth, an increase in global trade, demand for (new) energy, and climate change are driving forces, we challenge you to make your mark in finding innovative and relevant solutions for complex infrastructural and marine projects.

Within a vibrant company culture, you will be working as part of a diverse, international team of experts. We offer you the opportunity to realize your full personal potential and expand your professional career by creating new horizons. Together!

### **Interested?**

**Want to know more?**

We are more than happy to answer your questions about the position, please contact Melisha Nazareth, Corporate Recruiter, via our career page.

**Interested?** Please apply by filling in your details and by uploading your cover letter and CV on our careers site.

**Please note:** Boskalis never requests a financial contribution to arrange visas or other documents related to a job vacancy. Be wary of individuals who pretend to be our recruiters and ask for such contributions.

**Disclaimer for Recruiters and Recruitment Agencies**

We appreciate your interest in our vacancies and understand that your candidate might be enthusiastic about this exciting opportunity. However, our recruitment process is not structured this way; at Boskalis, we handle recruitment ourselves. Therefore, we do not accept unsolicited applications or CVs from recruitment agencies. Any submission will be treated as a direct application.

Job Description
  
  
As an Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Coordinator, you will support clients in the planning, implementation, management, and coordination of EHS requirements across operational facilities and office environments. You will play an important role in ensuring compliance with applicable regulations, promoting a strong safety culture, and supporting the effective management of environmental, health, and safety programmes.
  
  
The successful candidate will also be responsible for conducting and facilitating EHS seminars and training programmes, developing effective methods for monitoring EHS performance, and carrying out routine inspections to identify and mitigate potential workplace risks.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  
Ensure compliance with all applicable environmental, health, safety, and statutory legislation, regulations, and requirements.
  
  
Provide EHS policy guidance and support to clients, management teams, employees, and other stakeholders.
  
  
Review and advise on safe work procedures in collaboration with operational and project teams.
  
  
Conduct routine workplace inspections and audits to identify hazards and assess compliance with EHS requirements.
  
  
Recommend reasonably practicable measures to eliminate or minimise foreseeable risks to employees, visitors, and contractors.
  
  
Establish and promote EHS awareness and a positive safety culture across operational facilities and office environments.
  
  
Support the implementation and monitoring of environmental programmes, including waste management, environmental compliance, and sustainability initiatives, where required by the Client.
  
  
Monitor and review EHS programmes to ensure regulatory and organisational compliance.
  
  
Manage and maintain site- or facility-specific EHS documentation in accordance with client and regulatory requirements.
  
  
Respond to incidents and emergencies, assist in investigations, recommend corrective and preventive actions, and maintain accurate records and statistics.
  
  
Prepare and submit incident reports in accordance with EHS and organisational procedures.
  
  
Support the coordination and delivery of EHS inductions, briefings, awareness programmes, and training initiatives as required.
  
  
Perform other EHS-related duties and ad hoc assignments as required by the Client.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
Opportunities are available across multiple experience levels, depending on the complexity of the assignment and scope of responsibilities.
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Occupational Health& Safety, Workplace Safety & Health, or a related discipline.
  
  
Up to 3 years of relevant experience in an EHS, facilities, operations, or similar environment. Experience supporting technology-sector clients will be an advantage.
  
  
Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply. Placement level will be determined based on qualifications, experience, and available opportunities.
  
  
Strong interest in environmental, health, and safety management and regulatory compliance.
  
  
Positive attitude with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  
  
Stronganalytical, problem-solving, and organisational skills.
  
  
Strong administrative and document management skills with a high level of attention to detail.
  
  
Good interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
  
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and documentation management.
  
  
Knowledge of EHS regulations, compliance requirements, and industry best practices will be an advantage.

Contract (1 to 2 years), with extension or renewal subject to the Client's requirements and project needs.
